output.summary: KEP-2227 introduces the well-known annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container so kubectl commands (exec, attach, cp, logs) can pick a default container when --container is omitted, and deprecates kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-logs-container. The KEP is at implementable status, stage stable.
output.rationale: Operators running Pods with multiple containers must pass --container to every command, and the first-container default ties behaviour to container order, so commands like kubectl exec hit the wrong container (e.g. a service mesh sidecar). A single generic annotation avoids a new pod spec field, which the KEP says "would change pod spec and is not acceptable". Consumers outside kubectl are not covered, per the Non-Goals.

alternatives.option: Add a general default container name field to the pod spec
alternatives.why_not: The KEP states this 'would change pod spec and is not acceptable'.

alternatives.option: Use the -c / --container option in kubectl commands
alternatives.why_not: Listed under Alternatives without a stated rejection reason; the KEP keeps the -c flag and adds the annotation as a default when it is omitted (johnbelamaric: 'we'll certainly still need the -c flag').

alternatives.option: Keep kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-logs-container alongside the new annotation, with logs preferring it
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers (rikatz, pacoxu) raised keeping both; the KEP ultimately chose deprecation, with the old annotation working until 1.25 and its support later removed in 1.25 per the tracking comments.

evidence.quote: Define a default well-known annotation for Pods called `kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container` which points to Kubectl (and other commands) what's the default container to be used
We don't have a general default container name attribute for pod, and this would change pod spec and is not acceptable.
We need add a deprecation warn message for users with default-logs-container annotation and keep the old annotation working until 1.25.
we agreed to promote this to GA right away.
